title: kbmon's sprint panel takes over 10 s on this clone, so kbmon --status sprints says the panel is not readable (timeout)
goal: kbmon --status sprints reads the sprint panel within the panel timeout of 10 seconds on a clone with 18 sprints: mon_sprint.follows runs bl_plan.touches_meet over every open item pair of every sprint, about 22 million calls that each deep-copy the settings, so it takes about 14 s; it needs the open items' follows only for active sprints, or the touches expanded once, and no deep copy per call

run: import subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--status","sprints"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120); print(p.stdout); sys.exit(1 if p.returncode or "timeout" in p.stdout else 0)
